details: For every concept class, the star number is at least the co-VC dimension minus one.
proof_source: Full proof in the LaTeX survey: Lemma `lem:star-covc-affine`.
name: Star Number / co-VC dimension (affine)
witness_verification: For the family #classes/full_cube with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n$ and $0$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity as n tends to infinity, ruling out every reverse affine-linear bound. See the database-owned value proofs for these two endpoints.
